subject: SOC2 re-attestation — renewal sequencing, evidence cadence, and provisioning request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@brightpay.com>, Kate Lopez <kate.lopez@brightpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation — renewal sequencing, evidence cadence, and provisioning request

Hi Liz / Kate,

Quick intro — BrightPay's renewal is coming up on 2027-01-31. We're preparing the renewal package and want to align on the SOC2 re-attestation path and evidence cadence so procurement and security are comfortable with the renewal amendment and a proposed capacity uplift.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm desired retention horizon for audit logs (12 / 18 / 24 months)?
- Do you require a one-week sample export (dry run) before we start bulk evidence upload?
- Is BrightPay open to an 8% committed seat uplift and a short-term burst for the reassessment window? We will include pricing in the MAP.

Proposed timeline:
- Week of 11/16: mutual action plan + SOW draft
- Week of 11/23: dry-run export (if requested) and SOC2 evidence handoff begins
- Week of 12/07: DocuSign for amendment and put burst capacity in place

I've attached a draft MutualActionPlan.docx for your review and included Kimberly and Marissa on the thread to help with evidence logistics and renewal ops. If you prefer, we can discuss on a short call — 20 minutes to align the handoff and timeline.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): MutualActionPlan.docx (docx)

From: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@brightpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kate Lopez <kate.lopez@brightpay.com>
Cc: Emily Smith <emily.smith@brightpay.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation — renewal sequencing, evidence cadence, and provisioning request

Ben — thanks for the summary and MAP. A few initial items from security/procurement: 

1) Retention horizon: BrightPay's policy is 18 months for audit logs and 36 months for forensic artifacts. Can you confirm Redwood can support 18 months by default and export for longer on request?
2) Evidence formats: we prefer CSV exports for logs and PDF/ZIP for attestations/binders.
3) Sample export: yes, we'd like a one-week dry run (production subset) to validate schemas before bulk handoff. Target dates: 11/23-11/27.
4) SOC2 attestation: please provide a copy of your latest SOC2 Type II PDF and a short summary (what systems were in scope for 2025).
5) Procurement: Emily needs an updated SOW with the term change and a PO path; also any redlines to the Master Services Agreement must be highlighted up front.

Cc'ing Emily so procurement can chime in on PO and SOW items. We'll block time for the dry run if you can propose a 30-minute slot next week.

Regards,

Liz Harmon
Head of Security Operations | BrightPay
liz.harmon@brightpay.com
Attachment(s): none

Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation — renewal sequencing, evidence cadence, and provisioning request

Thanks Liz — great questions. Short answers below and next steps.

- Retention: Redwood can support 18 months as the default retention for audit logs. We can also provide an export package for forensic artifacts to meet your 36-month requirement on request (S3 export package).
- Formats: CSV/JSON for logs, PDF/ZIP for attestations — noted.
- Dry run: proposing Wed 11/24 10:00-10:30 PT for the sample export window. Please confirm.
- SOC2: attaching the public SOC2-type2-2025-summary.pdf and a short scope note in the Drive link.
- Procurement/SOW: Kimberly will coordinate the SOW and highlight any term changes. Marissa will coordinate evidence upload cadence.

Next steps: Jonas and Laura from our Solutions & Ops teams are on this thread to confirm the technical plan and the evidence upload runbook. Once we agree on the dry-run timing, we'll run a sample export and share the RetentionMatrix.xlsx mapping of logs to artifacts.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): SOC2-type2-2025-summary.pdf (pdf), RetentionMatrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation — renewal sequencing, evidence cadence, and provisioning request

Thanks — quick technical note to make the dry-run and bulk handoff predictable: 

- Evidence upload runbook: we'll provide an "evidence-upload-runbook.md" that outlines credentials, bucket naming conventions, file naming, and incremental upload APIs. Estimated prep for BrightPay: 2 engineer-days to validate schema and credentials.
- Log export: we'll create CSV exports grouped by service (auth, inference-api, audit-trail) with a max payload of 100k rows / file. We can also provide a streaming S3 export if you want continuous replication during the assessment window.
- Retention change & capacity: to enable the recommended 18-month retention and expected spike during evidence handoff, we suggest a 10% temporary capacity buffer (burst) for 6 weeks. This is non-disruptive and can be scoped in the amendment.

I've attached the runbook draft and tied it to specific deliverables in the MAP. Laura, can you confirm ops lead times for scheduling the burst?

Jonas Weber
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): evidence-upload-runbook.md (md)

From: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@brightpay.com>

Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation — renewal sequencing, evidence cadence, and provisioning request

Jonas — that looks good. A few clarifications: 

- For the dry-run, BrightPay will assign a security engineer to validate the CSV schema. Please send an example export (first-day sample) three days before the slot.
- The streaming S3 export option is preferred if feasible — please include S3 bucket naming conventions and IAM role template in the runbook.
- Procurement: Emily requests an updated SOW with the burst capacity line item and a short pricing appendix for the 8% committed seat uplift + 6-week burst.

Emily, can you confirm PO timing on your side? If procurement confirms an expedited PO path we can align the DocuSign timeline.

Thanks,

Liz
Head of Security Operations | BrightPay
